sar.narrative: Between 2016-12-03 and 2016-12-03, account C12265 on card C12265-K2 was subjected to unauthorized fraudulent activity consistent with account takeover. A total of 2 transaction(s) were flagged, representing an aggregate exposure of $108.45 USD. Investigation uncovered common infrastructure links to connected card(s) C05245-K2, C08374-K1, C07648-K2, C12942-K2, C12036-K2, C11000-K2, C07212-K1, C11309-K1, C02716-K1, C08605-K1, C08450-K2, C04108-K2, C12961-K2, C01109-K2, C12690-K2, C11143-K1, C09800-K1, C09274-K1, C08945-K2, C01138-K2, C09241-K2, C00854-K2, C03218-K2, C08842-K2, C06208-K1, C04125-K1, C06224-K2, C01155-K2, C05704-K2, C05530-K2, C07518-K2, C12897-K1, C08489-K2, C03040-K2, C00750-K2. Customer was contacted and reported: 'Customer denied the transaction when asked'. The pattern of unauthorized transactions diverges significantly from cardholder historical profile. Based on regulatory guidelines under FinCEN and bank fraud policy R2/R6, the card has been blocked and reissued, connected entities placed under heightened monitoring, and this report is submitted to document the illicit financial activity.
